title: Finger Exercise 19 — Container and Stack (LIFO)
statement:
Implement a `Container` base class and a `Stack` subclass.

`Container` (initializes `self.myList = []`):
- `size(self)` — return the length of the list.
- `add(self, elem)` — add `elem` to one end (keep the end consistent); returns nothing.

`Stack(Container)` — a **last-in, first-out** structure:
- `remove(self)` — remove and return the **newest** element added, or `None` if empty.

```
s = Stack(); s.add(1); s.add(2); s.remove() -> 2  (LIFO)
```

Source: MIT OCW 6.100L Fall 2022, Finger Exercise Lecture 19 (reconstructed as a runnable problem for this study tool).
